newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends barely up, seen firming.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends barely up, seen firming.

text.p: CSCE world sugar prices closed barely firmer in rangebound and thin dealings.

After falling to nearly six month lows last week, prices took a step back and consolidated losses. The market is seen gradually correcting losses and climbing higher, but the March contract will need to pierce 10.63 to confirm the uptrend, dealers said.
The March contract settled towards the middle of the day's range at 10.55, up 0.02, having ranged from 10.57 to 10.49. The deferred contracts finished 0.02 to 0.04 firmer.
Light speculative buying gave the March contract an early boost, but persistent producer selling capped the move higher.
Near-term support was seen at 10.46, with major support pegged at 10.29 and 10.21, basis the March contract.
Volume was estimated at only 6,746 lots.
Port authorities in Brazil said today sugar shipments from key ports reached 800,000 tonnes in October, compared with 730,990 tonnes for the same year-ago period.
